implemented_coverage.notes: Generic Llama-family profile handling is first-class. OpenLLaMA and TinyLlama now provide ungated declared support lanes, while access-gated vendor checkpoints remain omitted.

Shared qwen-family heuristics cover aliases beyond the declared text-only Qwen2, Qwen2.5 14B, Qwen3, and Qwen3.5 9B public lanes. Maintained image-text lanes cover Qwen3.5 2B, Qwen3.5 4B, and scoped Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6 27B through hf_multimodal with pinned VQAv2 input definitions.
Yi is treated as a RoPE decoder family in profile and adapter-auto logic.
Phi-family selectors are first-class. Phi-4 now has a declared text-only lane via the reasoning-plus pilot, while multimodal Phi-4 remains backlog-only.

Gemma-family selectors and loaders are first-class for compatible local or user-supplied checkpoints. Maintained Gemma catalog lanes include Gemma 4 E2B text-only plus Gemma 4 E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B, and 31B image-text evaluation.
These families are available through shared GPT-style loader and profile paths rather than dedicated public support lanes.
Falcon 7B now has a declared support lane; remaining Falcon-family coverage is available through adapter-auto heuristics and variant-path tests.
Family visibility currently comes from adapter-auto heuristics only.

DeepSeek distill checkpoints continue to share the qwen-family route. Oversized FP8 checkpoint-specific repo hooks and shipped configs were removed after bring-up showed that they do not fit the supported hardware/runtime path.
Loader and adapter-auto support exceeds the public BERT / RoBERTa support lane.
Concrete loader families exist beyond the public FLAN-T5 base seq2seq basis; mBART/PEGASUS/Marian still need dedicated presets and public evidence before they become declared support lanes.
